description.narrative: (USAID Global Health (GH)): The goal of Project UChoose is to advance the research, development, and understanding of safe, effective, and affordable contraceptive methods which will better enable women to make decisions around their family planning needs. Project activities include developing a versatile, long-acting, biodegradable pellet system and inserter that would better meet user needs and preferences, while minimizing the need for removal procedures which can place a burden on clients and health systems. Activities also include completion and data analysis for a clinical trial evaluating the mucosal impact of contraceptive use and developing clinical and laboratory methods to evaluate novel contraceptive safety endpoints. Project UChoose also includes a technology incubator aimed at generating proof-of-concept data for promising new contraceptive technologies. Activities in the incubator include development of a 3D-printed intrauterine device and pre-clinical effectiveness studies of novel non-hormonal compounds. The project focuses on collecting new data on the impact of highly effective contraceptives on women's health and strengthening research capacity in Africa.
